organization_note: Xiaomi Corporation, incorporated in the Cayman Islands and listed in Hong Kong, gives its address at the Xiaomi Campus on Anningzhuang Road, Haidian District, Beijing, which its annual report names as its head office and principal place of business in the Chinese Mainland. It develops the Xiaomi MiMo models and publishes them under the XiaomiMiMo organizations. One name, Xiaomi, covers the models in the catalog.
